---
name: Question
about: Ask a how-do-I question that is not a bug and not a feature request
title: "[question] "
labels: ["type:question", "status:needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

**Note**: open-ended questions are usually better in
[GitHub Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/cardscape/cardscape/discussions/categories/q-a).
Use the issue tracker only for questions that have a
specific, in-scope answer.

## What I'm trying to do

A short description of the goal.

## What I've tried

What you already tried, including links to the docs you read,
the commands you ran, the errors you saw.

## What I expected

The answer or behavior you expected.

## My environment

- Cardscape version: commit / tag / branch
- .NET SDK: `dotnet --version`
- OS: (Windows / macOS / Linux)
- Database provider: (SQLite / PostgreSQL / MariaDB)
- MCP client (if MCP): (Claude Desktop / Cursor / ...)

## Why I'm filing an issue instead of a Discussion

One sentence on why this needs an issue (and not a discussion).
For example: "I'm asking here because the answer is a yes/no
that affects a specific decision in the code."
